description: Source code implementing UCI configuration management functions for wireless and network interfaces within the prplMesh project, including functions to get wireless interface parameters, options by section type, and LAN interfaces.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value for a given path.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_wireless_int
methods.description: Gets an integer wireless parameter from a specified interface.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_wireless_from_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves a wireless configuration parameter value for a specific interface name.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_wireless_bool
methods.description: Gets a boolean wireless parameter from a specified interface.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_all_options_by_section_type
methods.description: Retrieves all options of a specific type within a UCI package section.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_lan_interfaces
methods.description: Gets LAN interface names for a specified network.
